network_status.network: Modellazione idrologica del bacino del Cedrino alla diga Pedra 'e Othoni
network_status.summary_it: Lo studio ARPAS identifica una stazione sul Cedrino a Oloè, ma calibra il modello sui deflussi alla diga Pedra 'e Othoni e non pubblica nel documento un valore numerico evento-specifico per il ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAS study identifies a Cedrino gauge at Oloè but calibrates the model on inflow at the Pedra 'e Othoni dam and publishes no event-specific numeric value for the bridge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
